sourceReceipts.finding: Current operator homepage. It links customer services but does not publish a reusable nationwide delivery-assignment or postal-area release.
The page links Oficinas y Códigos Postales to the service-points directory. No bulk-data reuse or public-serving licence was located.

The page describes the national office network as 812 post offices and provides office-name, address, postcode, service and province/municipality filters. It is an office directory, not a delivery-area or complete active-code denominator.

The public client queries the oficinas action and renders name, office address, telephone, postcode, opening hours, municipality and province. It defines no point coordinates, Polygon/MultiPolygon, postal membership or validity fields.

sourceReceipts.edition: one public UI-equivalent first-page observation; no filters
sourceReceipts.finding: The response reports total 841 and returns 10 public institutional office rows. Thirteen fields describe office identity, address, phone, postcode, schedule, services, municipality and province; no geometry field exists. The 841 API count disagrees with the page narrative of 812.

One-page format reference states five digits before the locality, preceded by CP, and gives CP 10600 and CP 10300 examples. It is not a current complete assignment, validity register or geometry release.
The product provides postcode/locality suggestions, verification and format validation. The page documents no Polygon/MultiPolygon response.

UPU does not guarantee accuracy, accessibility, integrity or timeliness and may change material without notice; a current production release therefore requires its own pinned edition and receipt.

sourceReceipts.edition: UPU quick guide created 2024-01-26; three pages
sourceReceipts.finding: Functions validate postcode format and postcode/locality relations. Page 3 requires an API key obtained by registration and says free-call allocation, costs and trials are provider-managed; no area geometry is documented.

sourceReceipts.edition: UPU CDS guide modified 2024-09-23; two pages
sourceReceipts.finding: CDS activation requires a country-unique security token received from a regional support centre. The tested effect is locality suggestion for a postcode, not geometry.

applicationAssessment.reasonBrowserE2eNotRun: No rights-cleared complete current CU assignment and no real postal Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact exists. Browser execution would exercise shared code or the synthetic fixture only and cannot promote CU to M2.

blocker.summary: The public Correos surface is an internally inconsistent office directory, while UPU lookup is credentialed and redistribution-restricted; neither source provides a rights-cleared current assignment denominator joined to postal area geometry.
reasons: Correos describes 812 offices but its current public query reports 841; office records do not establish every active delivery postcode, exclusions, validity, aliases or service-area membership.
Correos publishes no point coordinates or Polygon/MultiPolygon in the reviewed office contract, and a postal-office postcode or address must not be expanded into an area.
The UPU Cuba sheet is dated 09/2004 and provides format examples only.
UPU POST*CODE requires registration/API keys or country tokens, documents lookup/validation rather than area geometry, and UPU copyright does not authorize AGID redistribution or public serving.
No official or rights-cleared derived CU postal-area release, immutable artifact, real API response or app visualization was available.
unblockConditions: Identify a public, versioned and complete current Correos de Cuba assignment release with denominator, validity, aliases, exceptions and typed non-area objects, or obtain separately approved licensed access and rights.
Identify a versioned official or rights-cleared derived postal-area Polygon/MultiPolygon release with stable identifiers, CRS, validity, topology and a complete explicit crosswalk to drawable codes.
Obtain terms explicitly permitting AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public API/map serving for the assignment, geometry and derived artifact.

Build an immutable artifact and verify real CU normalization, API contract, geometry validity, map fit, translucent fill, clear outline, states, provenance, clear and re-search through the application.
